fusions.name: Marking Sap
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of scented sap that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Snare
fusions.desc: Snaps a noose of vine shut on one enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit and grows to as much as 1.5 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Scent on the Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Wilting Quarry
fusions.desc: You deal 15% more damage to enemies at low health.
